messages:
marisa: Hey team — planning to onboard catalina-13b-compact and pin it to slot 42 tomorrow 2026-04-10 09:30 PST. Requesting smoke window + rollback plan.

sasha: I can run the smoke at 09:30. what's the canary % and expected latency profile?

marisa: start with canary 5% (slot pinned but traffic routing uses 5% weight). latency expected avg 120ms p95 220ms for 512 tokens. loadtest ran ok in staging.

lucas: I'll watch infra metrics and kv cache hit rate; @aj please standby for oncall alerts.

aj: ack, oncall standby. set pager rules to escalate at error rate > 1% or 500ms p95 increase.

kevin: I'll update catalog metadata (description, quantization tag) right before pin. also will push alias -> slot mapping after smoke passes.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by marisa at 2026-04-10T16:30Z to slot 42. Canary: 5%. Hooks: smoke-check, metric-watch.

marisa: Smoke checklist:
1) Run smoke script
```bash
./scripts/smoke_catalog.sh --model catalina-13b-compact --slot 42 --count 50
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"model":"catalina-13b-compact","input":"smoke test"}'
```
2) Check p95, error rate, kv cache hit
3) Run quick evals on 10 golden prompts (kevin has list)
4) Confirm alias swap ready

sasha: Will run the script and post results here. plan to start at 09:30 PST sharp.

lucas: If anything wrong, rollback command is:
`catalog pin swap --slot 42 --model alias/previous-catalina`

marisa: If smoke passes at +10m, increase to 25% then 100% at +30m. If any step fails, rollback immediate.

kevin: metadata updates staged in PR #789, will merge 15min before. Also confirming quantization=4bit.

sasha: smoke results: 50/50 requests ok, p95 210ms, error 0. tpu caches look fine. :thumbsup:

marisa: thanks! proceeding to 25% now.

deploy-bot: Canary increase to 25% executed.

aj: No alerts so far. monitoring green.

lucas: metrics look stable. ready for full rollout in 15m if still green.

marisa: Full rollout in 15m, tagging release `catalina-13b-compact@20260410` and pin confirmed. Thanks team :rocket:

kevin: alias updated: `latest-catalina` -> slot 42

sasha: closing thread, will add notes to onboarding doc.
